status: Two verified consecutive 100,000-agent runs through Playground and Restart with full recursive inspection
scope: CLI benchmark with the actual playground collector; browser rendering at 100,000 agents remains to be verified
interpretation: Single-shard runs reproduced heartbeat-watchdog eviction under storage pressure. Eight native EKV shards completed both measured runs without heartbeat eviction. WAL high-water files remain allocated while checkpointed space is reusable; logical file size is not a count of retained agent snapshots.
limitations: Two runs are not a long-duration stress guarantee. Native consensus metadata for fresh identities is separate from deleted agent snapshots. Profiling and other local services can affect timing.
